hero.heading: I turn raw data into business decisions.
hero.subtitle: Business and data analyst with nearly four years onsite at Google through Vaco and an MSc in Business Analytics (Distinction). I build analysis pipelines and interactive dashboards that turn data into decisions.

about.text: I completed my MSc in Management (Business Analytics) with Distinction at Swansea University in January 2026. Before that I spent nearly four years as an Associate Analyst at Vaco Binary Semantics, working onsite at Google in Gurugram on reporting, dashboards and process improvement, and training new joiners. My approach: start with the business question, then work backwards through the data. I use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT day to day to speed up research and analysis. I'm on a UK Graduate visa with full right to work, and available for full-time work immediately.

services.heading: My expertise
services.description: Turning complex data into clear business value.

items.title: Data Analysis & EDA
items.text: Deep-dive exploratory analysis, hypothesis testing, and statistical modelling to uncover actionable insights from messy real-world datasets.

items.title: Interactive Dashboards
items.text: Interactive dashboards with Plotly.js, Tableau, and advanced Excel. Live, filterable, and built for stakeholder decision-making.

items.title: Machine Learning
items.text: End-to-end ML pipelines with scikit-learn — from feature engineering to model evaluation. Churn prediction, classification, regression.
